figures.title: Sample space grid for two rolls
figures.description: A 4 by 4 grid representing the 16 possible outcomes of two rolls. The horizontal axis is labeled 'X = First roll' with columns numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4 from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled 'Y = Second roll' with rows numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4 from bottom to top. Each cell in the grid corresponds to a pair of roll outcomes (X, Y).
